meta.title: 用几分钟彻底搞懂MTF曲线
meta.title_en: Fully Understand the MTF Curve in Minutes

scenes.context: MTF是调制传递函数的英文缩写，描述了镜头的光学特性。别从理科角度理解，可以把它理解为光线经过镜头透射后产生的影像。好的镜头能量损失越小，MTF数值越接近1。语域：摄影教学，概念讲解。
sentences: MTF 描述了镜头的光学特性。
MTF describes a lens's optical characteristics.
optical characteristics（光学特性）
光线经过镜头，能量会下降。
Light loses energy passing through the lens.
loses energy（能量下降）
越好的镜头，MTF 越接近 1。
Better lenses get MTF closer to 1.
closer to 1（接近1）
paraphrase: 调制传递函数 → modulation transfer function / MTF
光学特性 → optical characteristics / lens quality
scenes.speak: MTF describes a lens's optical characteristics. Light loses energy passing through the lens. Better lenses get MTF closer to 1.

scenes.context: MTF采样测量方法：用相机拍摄黑白相间的条纹（光学上叫光栅），单位是线对每毫米，一般用10线对和30线对代表低分辨率和高分辨率。光线经过镜头会产生衰减和干扰，让纯黑的地方也不是那么黑，反差下降。语域：摄影教学，测量方法。
sentences: 用相机拍黑白条纹来测量。
It's measured by shooting black-and-white bars.
black-and-white bars（黑白条纹）
单位是线对每毫米。
The unit is line pairs per millimeter.
line pairs（线对）
干扰让纯黑的地方不黑了。
Interference keeps true black from staying black.
interference（干扰）
paraphrase: 线对 → line pairs / spatial frequency
scenes.speak: It's measured by shooting black-and-white bars. The unit is line pairs per millimeter. Interference keeps true black from staying black.

scenes.context: MTF曲线：横轴是向场从中心到边缘的距离，纵轴是影像的反差，理想最大值为1。红色曲线代表低分辨率反差，蓝色代表高分辨率。每种颜色都分实线和虚线，代表光栅水平和垂直状态。语域：摄影教学，曲线解读。
sentences: 横轴是中心到边缘的距离。
The x-axis is distance from center to edge.
center to edge（中心到边缘）
纵轴是反差，最大为 1。
The y-axis is contrast, capped at 1.
capped at 1（最大为1）
红曲线低分辨率，蓝曲线高分辨率。
Red is low resolution, blue is high resolution.
low vs high resolution（低/高分辨率）
paraphrase: 横轴 → x-axis / the horizontal axis
scenes.speak: The x-axis is distance from center to edge. The y-axis is contrast, capped at 1. Red is low resolution, blue is high resolution.

scenes.title_en: Judging a Lens from the Curve
scenes.context: 判断镜头好坏：MTF曲线尽量接近1而且平直；不同分辨率（10线对和30线对）的曲线落差越小越好；中心成像最好，离中心越远越差。收小光圈（如F8）光学特性会变好；变焦镜头的广角端中心边缘落差更大。语域：摄影教学，实用判断。
sentences: 好镜头曲线接近 1 且平直。
A good lens is near 1 and stays flat.
stays flat（平直）
10 线和 30 线落差越小越好。
The smaller the 10/30-line gap, the better.
the gap, the better（落差越小越好）
中心成像最好，边缘变差。
The center is sharpest; edges fall off.
edges fall off（边缘变差）
paraphrase: 落差 → gap / difference between curves
scenes.speak: A good lens is near 1 and stays flat. The smaller the 10/30-line gap, the better. The center is sharpest; edges fall off.

practice: MTF describes a lens's optical characteristics.
It's measured by shooting black-and-white bars.
The x-axis is distance from center to edge.
A good lens is near 1 and stays flat.
pitfalls: The center is sharpest; edges fall off.
The smaller the 10/30-line gap, the better.
Stopping down to f/8 improves the optics.
Light loses energy passing through the lens.
「MTF」就是能量衰减和反差的数学表达。
shifts: 用 optical characteristics（光学特性）、focal field（向场）、resolution（分辨率）
用 contrast（反差）、line pairs（线对）、center to edge（中心到边缘）
用 black-and-white bars（黑白条纹）、10/30-line gap（线对落差）、stopping down（收光圈）
footer_notes: 转录基于图文实录完整口播。已校正：MTF是调制传递函数、描述光学特性、能量损失越小越接近1、黑白条纹测量、线对每毫米、10/30线对、干扰让纯黑不黑、反差下降、横轴中心到边缘、纵轴反差最大1、红低分辨率蓝高分辨率、实线虚线水平垂直、接近1且平直、落差越小越好、中心最清晰边缘变差、收光圈光学变好等。
